risks.description: recoverIncompleteRunsOnStartup() queries ALL active incomplete runs without per-run filtering
risks.impact: If Run B is still 'active' during Run A recovery, both get recovered (fire-and-forget). However, PR pre-existence check prevents duplicate PRs.
risks.mitigation: Ensure Run B reaches 'DONE' (finished_at set) before Run A recovery scan
risks.verified: Run B's state machine path completes to DONE, setting finished_at

risks.description: Global 'let' variables (db, adapters) shared within same process
risks.impact: Without Redis (synchronous execution), no concurrency risk. With Redis, BullMQ isolates jobs.
risks.mitigation: BullMQ job isolation; without Redis, runs are sequential
risks.verified: Worker concurrency=2 with Redis, but local dev has no Redis

risks.impact: Properly scoped — each run gets its own directory

risks.description: External writes to SQLite require WAL checkpoint before server sees them
risks.impact: If DB is modified externally between runs, server may not see changes
risks.mitigation: Always run PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) after external writes

overall_risk: AMBER — manageable with proper run sequencing (Run B completes before recovery scan)
